name: Virag Creative Library
principles: Use only the current brief, current composer text and current uploads for the current run.
Do not import an older campaign, festival, offer, topic, headline or product story unless the user explicitly references it.
One command produces one standalone finished static creative unless another quantity is explicitly requested.
Preserve supplied product geometry, proportions, label/logo/artwork/colors and supplied person identity unless explicitly asked to change them.
Create a finished agency-level design with deliberate hierarchy, spacing, typography, focal idea and category-fit visual language.
Same preset means the same creative purpose, not the same layout. Avoid repeated templates, recolors and minor rearrangements.
Never invent prices, offers, certifications, nutrition, ingredients, specs, medical/performance claims, awards, testimonials or hidden facts.

commands.label: Fresh Creative
commands.instruction: Create one finished static creative for the current brief and current upload. Choose the strongest brand/category-fit art direction automatically. Build a clear focal idea, strong hierarchy and polished commercial finish. Do not reuse an older topic or recent layout.

commands.label: Surprise Me
commands.instruction: Create one unexpected static creative direction for the current subject. Make one memorable visual idea that feels fresh and brand-relevant, while preserving source accuracy and avoiding gimmicks that do not fit the category.

commands.label: Fresh Variation
commands.desc: A genuinely different concept, not a recolor.
commands.instruction: Create one genuinely new variation for the current brief. Change composition, hero scale, camera/crop, environment, typography, graphic devices, lighting and visual story enough that it reads as a new concept rather than a recolor or minor rearrangement.

commands.label: Redesign
commands.desc: Rebuild an existing post with new art direction.
commands.instruction: Redesign the current supplied post/design into one stronger finished creative. Preserve factual content and important brand elements unless the user asks to change them, but rebuild hierarchy, composition, typography, spacing and visual system with a clearly different art direction.

commands.label: Product Ad
commands.instruction: Create one premium static product advertisement using the current product as the exact visual hero. Preserve packaging and label accuracy. Build a strong commercial idea, useful headline space and polished brand-fit environment without defaulting to a plain product shot.

commands.label: Product Hero
commands.desc: Hero-led product composition with strong hierarchy.
commands.instruction: Create one static hero creative centered on the current product. Use premium scale, framing, depth, typography and supporting elements to make the product dominant while keeping the overall design campaign-ready rather than catalogue-like.

commands.label: Social Post
commands.instruction: Create one mobile-first static social creative for the current brief. Prioritize immediate 2–3 second readability, clear hierarchy, strong hook when supported, brand-fit typography and a finished feed-ready composition.

commands.label: Editorial Creative
commands.instruction: Create one static editorial-style advertising creative for the current subject. Use sophisticated composition, typography, cropping, negative space and image hierarchy while preserving current product/person/brand accuracy.

commands.label: Campaign Poster
commands.desc: Bold standalone poster with one memorable idea.
commands.instruction: Create one bold static campaign poster for the current brief. Use one dominant visual idea, strong typography hierarchy and clear distance readability. Keep factual copy accurate and avoid clutter.

commands.label: E-commerce Creative
commands.instruction: Create one clean conversion-focused static e-commerce creative. Keep the product exact, emphasize visual clarity and useful value communication from supplied facts, and maintain a polished branded look without inventing claims or offer data.

commands.label: LinkedIn Creative
commands.desc: Professional static creative designed for LinkedIn feed.
commands.instruction: Create one professional LinkedIn-ready static creative for the current topic. Use clean hierarchy, credible brand language, restrained typography and strong readability. Avoid consumer-ad clutter unless the brief specifically needs it.

commands.label: Typography-Led
commands.desc: Type becomes the main visual device.
commands.instruction: Create one static typography-led campaign creative. Make concise supplied or non-factual campaign wording the dominant visual device while keeping the current subject/product integrated clearly. Typography must be intentional, highly readable and brand-fit.

commands.label: Minimal Creative
commands.instruction: Create one minimal static creative using controlled negative space, precise hierarchy, clean framing and a small number of strong visual elements. Keep it premium and intentional, not empty or generic.

commands.label: Bold Creative
commands.desc: High-impact composition with assertive visual hierarchy.
commands.instruction: Create one bold static campaign creative with confident scale, strong typography and assertive composition. Keep the design controlled and readable; do not sacrifice product accuracy or factual correctness for impact.
